item.title: California spends billions based on this pollution tracker. Who benefits from its latest update?
item.description: California is updating CalEnviroScreen, the influential pollution tracker that helps determine which communities get environmental grants. Advocates say the state should improve the tool and use it more frequently to cut pollution. The post California spends billions based on this pollution tracker. Who benefits from its latest update? appeared first on Long Beach Post.
